_comment: Project-level MCP servers. Checked into the repo so every contributor gets the same servers. The github server fetches its token from `gh auth token` at spawn time (no rc-file export needed), so run `gh auth login` first; classic or fine-grained PAT with repo + workflow scopes. To rotate: `gh auth refresh -s repo,workflow`. First run pulls ghcr.io/github/github-mcp-server (~30 MB).

args: GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN=$(gh auth token) exec docker run -i --rm -e GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN ghcr.io/github/github-mcp-server
